enable_self_reg.description:i18n: Visitors can create their own account. When this is off, only administrators can add users.

enable_user_pwd_choice.title:i18n: Let users select their own passwords
enable_user_pwd_choice.description:i18n: People who sign up choose their password themselves. When this is off, new accounts get no password and have to reset it.

use_email_as_login.title:i18n: Use email address as login name
use_email_as_login.description:i18n: Allows users to login with their email address instead of specifying a separate login name.
